title: BIDS Format Support and DuckDB Backend
text: PhysioIO provides two complementary features managing collections physiological recordings: BIDS support – read write data Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) format, community standard organizing neuroimaging electrophysiology datasets. title: Guide to Supported File Formats
text: HDF5 ideal large datasets supports chunked, compressed, --memory storage. PhysioIO uses Bioconductor rhdf5 HDF5Array packages data can remain disk operate . Reference: HDF Group (1997–2024). “Hierarchical Data Format, version 5.” https://www.hdfgroup.org/HDF5/
